name: investment-toolkit-plugins
description: Investment Toolkit plugins: AI stock valuation, portfolio advisor (health, rebalancing, strategy review), and suite orchestration.

plugins.name: stock-valuation
plugins.description: AI-driven autonomous stock valuation and research engine. Skills: /evaluate-stock (Bear/Base/Bull DCF projections with analyticsLog), /research-stock (qualitative sweep with Class A/B/C/D change classification and decision gate before re-valuation), /forward-valuation-challenge (stress-test valuations against trailing financials), /valuation-math-validation (deterministic DCF math and spread checks).

plugins.name: portfolio-advisor
plugins.description: Investment portfolio advisor suite. /daily — one interactive daily command: portfolio sync check, morning brief (macro regime + TA sweep + conviction scores + earnings calendar), ranked triage cards (one per holding, urgency-ordered), trade execution, self-evolution log. Plus: /review-portfolio, /strategic-review, /rebalance, /calibrate-targets, /update-portfolio-targets, /x-news-sweep, /bundle-thesis-review, /13f-tracker, /13f-analyze, /run-advisor (post-catalyst orchestrator). Evolution log: plugins/portfolio-advisor/references/evolution-log.md.

plugins.name: toolkit-manager
plugins.description: Orchestrator for the Investment Screener suite. Handles server startup (/start-screener) and Questrade API token seeding (/setup-questrade).

plugins.name: etf-analysis
plugins.description: AI-driven ETF and fund analysis engine. Three fund types: CLOSED_END, THEMATIC_ETF, CASH_FUND. Trigger: /analyze-etf {TICKER}.

plugins.name: tradingview
plugins.description: TradingView Desktop integration via CDP. Skills: /tv-portfolio-sync, /place-order, /modify-order, /cancel-order, /get-orders, /tv-price-refresh, /tv-alert-sync, /tv-snapshot, /pine-inject, /author-pine-script, /tv-ta-deep, /ta-daily-sweep (batch TA scan of all portfolio holdings — flags, volume anomalies, DCF cross-reference, ranked report). Agents: ta-guide (interactive TA tutor + Pine Script architect). Chart control: addIndicator (Input.dispatchMouseEvent, container-WeNdU0sq selector), removeIndicator, changeTimeframe, changeSymbol, readDataWindow, openDataWindow, sweep (batch symbol scan). Pine: lint (pine_linter.py), inject, save to TV library, read source from Indicators dialog (open-source scripts only — PA Toolkit IS open source CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Custom indicators: plugins/tradingview/assets/pinescript-indicators/. Close Pine Editor before calling addIndicator. Requires TV Desktop with --remote-debugging-port=9222.
